title: An Unexpected Day in Kyoto

before.title: An Unexpected Day in Kyoto
before.text: In Kyoto, Hana needed help after the bus had left. They had planned to see a quiet temple. A shop owner listened and drew a map. Hana repeated the new way before leaving. It took more time than the first plan. Still, it led past small lights by the river. The kind help became the best part of the day. Hana went home ready to welcome another new plan.

after.title: An Unexpected Day in Kyoto
after.text: In Kyoto, Hana missed the bus to a temple. She asked a shop owner for help. He drew a map to another bus stop. Hana thanked him and took the next bus. On the way, she saw small lights by the river. She reached the temple later than planned. At home, she told her family about the helpful shop owner.
after.factScope: Fictional scene; no documented real person, event, route or universal outcome asserted.

reason: Replaced ambiguous singular-they references and implausibly indirect resolution with one named traveler, a second bus stop and an explicit arrival. The anecdote is fictional; it does not assert a real Kyoto route.
